basics.name: Alejandro Salvatierra
basics.label: Solutions Architect & DevOps Engineer
basics.summary: Solutions Architect and DevOps Engineer with 4+ years of experience in software development. I started as a Full Stack developer (Java Spring and Angular) and specialised in CI/CD, Kubernetes (OpenShift and Google Cloud) and automation. Today at GPI Group I design solution architectures for our clients and drive infrastructure decisions, while remaining responsible for pipelines and releases.

work.name: GPI Group
work.summary: Evolution of my DevOps role towards solution architecture for the group's clients.

Defining the CI/CD, deployment and observability standards adopted by development teams.
Technical point of reference between development teams, operations and clients for architectural decisions.
Still responsible for GitLab/Jenkins pipelines, Kubernetes clusters and releases.
